name: Major Surface Curse
description: a creature can never be in the presence of natural light. It takes 9 (2d8) radiant damage at the beginning of its turn if it is exposed to direct moonlight or sunlight. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hp, it dies and turns to moondust.
